race.comment: The Smyth camp have KING'S DUTY (2) flying, putting two on the bounce before finishing third as a well supported fav here last time. Keeps Satherley piloting and only needs to hold his form to be right there again. BETTER THAN WORDS (7) was much better here third-up when chasing the red-hot The Defender into third. Gets in light and will relish the extra 100m. Can give this a shake. GOOD LIEUTENANT (1) hasn't won for a long time and while his form is patchy, there are peaks there that can measure up. OUTWITTED (3) has been freshened with a month between runs after two flat performances in the hopes of sparking him back up. Keeping safe.
